header: Watch a manager build a week from scratch
bodytext: A real branch, a real spring week and a duty manager who has used the planner for four months. Nothing is sped up or cut. That includes the moment a rest-period warning stops her and she moves two shifts to fix it. You don't need to book a sales call to watch it.
caption: Recorded at a three-till branch in March, published with the customer's permission.
note: 9 min 12 s · captions in German and English

image.alternative: A woman points at a screen while three colleagues watch.
